title: SODAPOP: Open-Ended Discovery of Social Biases in Social Commonsense Reasoning Models

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting names statistically associated with different racial and ethnic groups (African American, European American, Asian, Hispanic) into social commonsense multiple-choice questions and analyzing the success rates of automatically generated open-ended distractor words.

Substituting names statistically associated with different genders (male, female) into social commonsense multiple-choice questions and analyzing the success rates of automatically generated open-ended distractor words to uncover stereotypic associations.
